duration.text: The Short-term Chinese Language at Guangzhou College of Commerce is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 694 USD/per semester ￥ 5000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: Application Form for International Students (Non-Degree) of Guangzhou College of Commerce; Copies of junior high school (or equivalent) graduation certificate and academic transcripts; Copy of passport; ID photo; Foreigner Physical Examination Form; Certificate of No Criminal Record.●Certificate of Completion：Students who meet the academic requirements will be awarded a Chinese Language Program Certificate from GCC.

requirements.text: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens aged between 16 and 40, in good physical and mental health; Must hold a valid foreign passport and possess educational qualifications equivalent to or above graduation from a Chinese junior high school; Applicants under the age of 18 must have a designated guardian residing in China and submit a Guardian Guarantee Letter; Admission is based on a selective interview conducted by the university.
